{{Quote|Trade Federation battle droids! They're wiping out the gundarks!|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=TU3-WNARN-L64.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
A '''skirmish''' occurred at a [[Unidentified gundark nest|nest]] of [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]], a predatory [[Species/Legends|species]], on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] sometime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]]. At the [[Time/Legends|time]], two factions were attempting to [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonize]] Alaris Prime&mdash;[[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] and the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], an [[The galaxy/Legends|intergalactic]] company. The Wookiees had previously [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|obtained]] the rights to colonize Alaris Prime legally from the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], while the Trade Federation had ignored the Senate's ruling and illegally landed on the moon to pursue their own interests. On Alaris Prime, both groups were attacked by the gundarks, prompting them to take action against the creatures by [[Death/Legends|eliminating]] them.

The Federation sent a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s from its [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]] to the gundark's nest, while the Wookiees trained a small band of [[Soldier/Legends|warriors]] under the leadership of the Wookiee [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]]. The Trade Federation reached the nest and began attacking, killing many of the gundarks, while the Wookiees arrived a short time later as the final gundarks were eliminated. As soon as they saw the Wookiees, the [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] opened fire on them, but the colonists fought back and overcame the [[Droid/Legends|droids]], destroying all of them. The skirmish rendered gundarks an extinct species on Alaris Prime and led to further battles between the Wookiees and the Trade Federation.

==Prelude==
===A new world===
{{Quote|An unexplored world is a hostile world. I must help the Wookiee leader Attichitcuk to learn the lay of the land. Only then can we find an appropriate place to settle.|Qui-Gon Jinn|audio=HelpingAttichitcuk.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Alarisprime.jpg|thumb|right|150px|Both the Trade Federation and the Wookiees sought to colonize Alaris Prime after it's rediscovery.]]
Sometime between the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] [[59 BBY/Legends|59 BBY]] and [[56 BBY/Legends|56 BBY]],<ref name="NEC & GB">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' placed the [[Alaris Prime colonial war|war]] for [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]] between [[39 BBY/Legends|39 BBY]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]], and the ''Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds'' databank stated that the debate for the rights took twenty years to resolve.</ref> [[Alaris Prime/Legends|Alaris Prime]], a [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of the [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Alaris/Legends|Alaris]], was [[Discovery of Alaris Prime|rediscovered]] by [[Scout/Legends|explorers]] of the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Species/Legends|species]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]]. These explorers, represented by the [[Wookiee Chieftain]] [[Attichitcuk/Legends|Attichitcuk]], [[Alaris Prime colonization resolution|petitioned]] the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], the dominant government in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], for the rights to lead a [[Alaris Prime colonial war|colonization effort]] on the moon. In the [[Politics/Legends|political]] debate that followed, the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], an intergalactic company, also expressed interest in Alaris Prime, believing it could be used as a trade center.<ref name="GB" />

The moon was eventually awarded to the Wookiees after twenty years of debate, with Attichitcuk being named one of the leaders of the [[Alaris Prime colonists|colonists]] for his role in gaining the rights. Fellow Wookiees [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] and [[Shoran]], Attichitcuk's [[Gender/Legends|son]]<ref name="GB" /> and nephew<ref name="TT">''[[Tyrant's Test]]''</ref> respectively, were also selected as colonial leaders, and [[Qui-Gon Jinn/Legends|Qui-Gon Jinn]], a [[Jedi Master/Legends|Master]] in the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], was ordered by the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] to oversee and advise the colonists in their efforts. The Wookiees set off for Alaris Prime<ref name="GB" /> sometime between [[39 BBY/Legends|39]] and [[36 BBY/Legends|36 BBY]];<ref name="NEC" /> however the Trade Federation and their [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Droid Army]], dissatisfied with the Senate's ruling, illegally launched their own colonization effort on Alaris Prime, arriving shortly before the Wookiees and establishing their initial settlements.<ref name="GB" />

===Gundark terrors===
{{Quote|The wind carries with it the threat of an attack. My Wookiee friends have barely learned to harvest food, and yet now I must somehow teach them to create a militia. This will be a great challenge. May the Force be with them.|Qui-Gon Jinn on the training of bowcaster troopers prior to the attack on the gundark nest|audio=TrainingWarriors.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Underattack.png|thumb|left|200px|Multiple gundark attacks on Wookiee settlements prompted the colonists to train an army.]]
One of the structures built by the Trade Federation was a [[Power core/Legends|power core]], which was attacked by [[Gundark/Legends|gundarks]],<ref name="GB" /> a [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]]<ref name="TEGAS">[[The Essential Guide to Alien Species (real-world book)|''The Essential Guide to Alien Species'']]</ref> predatory species on Alaris Prime, driving the Federation away from that area. When the Wookiees landed on the moon, the damaged power core was discovered by Chewbacca and Shoran while they were heading to a [[Attichitcuk's camp|camp]] built by Attichitcuk, and&mdash;acting on advice from Master Jinn&mdash;the two Wookiees destroyed the structure before continuing on their path. Once they reached the camp it was [[Attack on Attichitcuk's camp|attacked]] by four gundarks, and Chewbacca, Shoran and Attichitcuk were forced to fight and [[Death/Legends|kill]] the creatures. Shortly afterwards, the ruins of the power core were discovered by [[OOL-2]], a Trade Federation [[B1-series battle droid/Legends|B1-series battle droid]], who reported its destruction to the Federation's [[Viceroy of the Trade Federation/Legends|Viceroy]], [[Nute Gunray/Legends|Nute Gunray]]. OOL-2 stated that the power core had been destroyed by the gundarks, and Gunray ordered the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] to find the creatures and exterminate them, bringing their pelts to the Federation's [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] allies.<ref name="GB" />

The Wookiees began to set up more bases on Alaris Prime, including one [[Unidentified Wookiee command center|command center]] which was also [[Attack on the Wookiee command center|attacked]] by gundarks. The multiple attacks prompted Master Jinn to teach the Wookiees to train a small army of [[bowcaster trooper]]s to attack the creatures at their [[Unidentified gundark nest|nest]]. At [[Unidentified Wookiee base (gundark attack)|one of these bases]], which was led by Chewbacca, Jinn instructed several Wookiee workers to build a [[Barracks/Legends|troop center]] in order to train the warriors.<ref name="GB" /> Once more than ten [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] had been trained,<ref name="SW:GBP" /> Chewbacca led his [[Troop/Legends|troops]] towards the gundark's nest to attack. The Trade Federation also ordered a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of eleven [[Battle Droid Beta Version]]s go to the nest to destroy the gundarks.<ref name="GB" />

==The skirmish==
{{Quote|More enemies approaching. Destroy them.|A B1 battle droid upon seeing Chewbacca and his soldiers|audio=MoreEnemies.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
[[File:Gundark_nest.jpg|thumb|right|The Wookiees destroying the battle droids]]
The squad of [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]] reached the nest and began firing at the gundarks with their [[E-5 blaster rifle/Legends|E-5 blaster rifles]], killing many of the creatures. The Wookiees encountered two gundarks at a [[Water/Legends|river]] close to the nest and killed them with their [[Bowcaster/Legends|bowcasters]] before proceeding. The Wookiees reached the nest and witnessed the last of the gundarks being killed by the battle droids. As soon as all of the creatures were dead, one of the battle droids,<ref name="GB" /> perceiving little difference between the newcomers and the gundarks,<ref name="SW:GBP" /> ordered his comrades to attack the Wookiees. However the colonists fought back and destroyed all of the droids.<ref name="GB" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Excellent work! The Trade Federation is a dangerous foe, and we certainly haven't seen the last of them.|audio=SkirmishSummary.flac|Qui-Gon Jinn to the Wookiees after the attack|<ref name="GB" />}}
Immediately after the skirmish, Jinn congratulated Chewbacca and the Wookiees for their combat performance and realized that their colonization effort was going to take a different turn. As a result of the skirmish, gundarks became extinct on Alaris Prime, and the Wookiees gained a new enemy in the Trade Federation as they finally became aware of their presence on the moon. Attichitcuk later began a [[Scout/Legends|scouting]] expedition to see what he could discover about the Federation, and while doing so was [[Ambush of Attichitcuk|ambushed]] by a unit of battle droids. Attichitcuk was quickly [[Rescue of Attichitcuk|rescued]] by Chewbacca and a small group of Wookiee soldiers, but he had sustained injuries that prevented him from undertaking his major duties in the colonization for some [[Time/Legends|time]]. Chewbacca would later lead the Wookiees in [[Attack on the Trade Federation outpost|several]] [[Attack on the Trade Federation listening array|attacks]] on Trade Federation settlements on Alaris Prime, before the Wookiees drove the Federation off the moon in the [[Battle for Alaris Prime]].<ref name="GB" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|Chewbacca is dead! We cannot continue.|Qui-Gon Jinn if the player fails|audio=ChewieDead3.flac|<ref name="GB" />}}
The skirmish at the gundark nest was first mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' by [[Steven L. Kent]]<ref name="SW:GBP" />&mdash;published on [[November 7]], [[2001]],<ref name="PrimaDate">{{Amazon|url=Star-Wars-Galactic-Battlegrounds-Official/dp/0761537503|text=Star Wars Galactic Battlegrounds: Prima's Official Strategy Guide}}</ref> before appearing in the [[2001]] [[LucasArts]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds]]'', released on [[November 11]], 2001.<ref name="GBDate">{{GameSpot|url=games/star-wars-galactic-battlegrounds|text=Star Wars: Galactic Battlegrounds}}</ref>. The skirmish is featured in the third level of the Wookiee tutorial campaign&mdash;"Building an Army"&mdash;where the player controls the Wookiees and has to train an army to attack the gundarks. The player can instantly lose the level if Chewbacca is killed at any point,<ref name="GB" /> though the strategy guide notes that such an outcome is unlikely. The guide also recommends that the player create ten Wookiee [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] before attacking the nest in order to complete the mission, which this article uses as a guide for the number of Wookiees present in this skirmish.<ref name="SW:GBP" />
